openings: And they're off! Eight brave garden gnomes charge across the starting line!
The clapper drops! They burst away down the green velvet turf!
Away they go! Pointy hats bristling in the gentle British breeze!
We are underway at {course}! Watch the field closely, every gnome is hungry for glory!
The starter pistol sounds and the ceramic athletes leap into action!
overtakes: {leader} makes a daring move on the inside paver to pass {chaser}!
Sensational acceleration! {leader} sweeps past {chaser} into first place!
Boot to boot! {leader} claims the lead from {chaser}!
{leader} surges ahead! That is champion pedigree right there!
{leader} slips through a narrow opening to steal pole position from {chaser}!
stumbles: Disaster strikes! {runner} stumbles over a loose dandelion root!
Oh no! {runner} has lost their footing and taken a right royal tumble!
Down goes {runner}! A catastrophic loss of ceramic equilibrium!
{runner} trips over their own oversized buckle and goes skidding across the turf!
A calamitous wobble! {runner} goes head over heels into the grass!
springLaunchers: Good heavens! {runner} hits the spring launcher and takes to the skies!
Up, up and away! {runner} achieves supersonic gnome altitude!
Incredible airtime! {runner} catapults over the pack like a ceramic missile!
A tremendous bounce! {runner} lands squarely back on their boots with glorious momentum!
mudSplashes: Direct hit! {runner} plows headfirst into the muddy bog!
Mud everywhere! {runner}'s pristine white beard is now entirely peat-colored!
Sludge in the boots! {runner} is bogged down and wading through thick compost!
A dreadful splash! {runner} takes a face full of wet earth!
sprinklers: Incoming irrigation! {runner} gets drenched by the oscillating sprinkler!
Soaked to the bone! {runner} is spinning in circles from high-pressure water spray!
A sudden cloudburst! {runner} gets caught in the sprinkler crossfire!
collisions: Ouch! {runner} collides heavily with a rival gnome and ricochets sideways!
Ceramic on ceramic! A bruising encounter in mid-lane for {runner}!
No quarter asked, none given! {runner} bounces violently off the boundary border!
photoFinishes: It's neck and neck! Separated by a whisker of beard hair at the line!
Too close to call! We are going to the electronic photo finish cameras!
Incredible drama! They cross the line locked in absolute unison!
winnerCelebrations: Glorious victory for {winner}! A masterclass in horticultural athletics!
{winner} takes the chequered flag and the grand garden championship!
Unstoppable! {winner} etches their name into gnome racing immortality!
What a run! {winner} reigns supreme in the garden derby!
